title: AgentDFIR Action Graph
description: Who did what through whom: normalized/lineage.json and the JSON of `agentdfir lineage`. Every edge is backed by something the evidence records and carries its basis, the evidence state of the step, and source references to check it by hand; time proximity alone is never a basis. Node kinds and edge relations are open sets: a consumer MUST accept values it does not know (later revisions add kinds such as outcome nodes) and SHOULD treat them as opaque. Defined by .adfir spec 0.2.2; graphs written before 0.2.2 also validate (adfir_spec and limitations are optional).

adfir_spec.description: Spec revision whose edge rules the graph follows. From 0.2.2: an edge whose evidence_state is CORROBORATED cites a telemetry_ref or states in limitations why not.

truncated.description: True when the bounds left nodes or edges out; omitted counts them.

evidenceState.description: Corroboration state (see event.schema.json); empty when none was established.

knownKind.description: Node kinds AgentDFIR writes. human: the account that prompted; agent / subagent; tool_call (a recorded tool invocation; 'tool' is reserved for a tool definition); process (from endpoint telemetry); file; network (a host, address or login); cloud_resource; mcp_server; outcome is the effect of an action as an independent record shows it (attributes.effect: file_written, file_deleted, file_renamed, destination_reached, cloud_api_accepted, cloud_api_refused), reached from the file, network or cloud_resource node by a resulted_in edge; resource is reserved.

id.description: Unique within the graph; '<kind prefix>:<identity>', e.g. agent:main:<session>, tool:<event id>, process:<source>:<ref>.

from.description: A node id in this graph.

to.description: A node id in this graph.

basis.description: Why the edge exists, in words: a recorded id, a pid/ppid, a named path or destination, or a scored correlation.

evidence_state.description: The corroboration state of the recorded step the edge derives from.

confidence.description: Present on correlated edges only: the correlation's own confidence (correlate.MatchBasis). A correlated edge cites both the agent record and the telemetry record it was paired with.

limitations.description: What the edge does not show, in words (0.2.2). Includes what telemetry coverage and collection health say about the step: e.g. 'process telemetry partial: sequence gap in …', 'completeness unverified: process telemetry carries no sequence numbers', 'no network telemetry for this host'.

assurance.description: How the edge itself is known (optional). verified: an identifier or record both ends carry (recorded parent or tool_use id, pid/ppid in telemetry, a telemetry record of the effect, the host witness reading the file); corroborated: a scored correlation between two independent sources; inferred: only named in the recorded command or tool input.

sourceRef.description: A sealed artifact line (artifact_id, logical_path, line, offset, event_id) or a line of imported telemetry (telemetry_ref, a second witness).
